description: Predeclared FFT validation suites for the Kunlunxin P800. Correctness is checked against numpy (CPU, complex128) because the vendor torch.fft.fft caps at N <= 2048.

support.note: All powers of two. fft_dit and fft_dif are both exercised at every size.

requirements: rel_err < 1e-4 vs numpy at every size

full.description: Full published grid including the multi-megabyte sizes the vendor baseline cannot reach.
requirements: rel_err < 1e-4 vs numpy at every size
report max_err and rel_err per size
